name: Alpine route planning
bio: Match a route to the team's experience, weather and terrain.

image.alt: Climber ascending a rugged cliff with a backpack

name: Climbing systems
bio: Use climbing systems and agreed movement practices on exposed terrain.

image.alt: Climber scaling a rugged outdoor surface

name: High-altitude readiness
bio: Plan a gradual ascent and monitor health throughout a high-altitude climb.

image.alt: Climber wearing a helmet on a steep rock face

name: Snow and ice movement
bio: Learn footwork and ice-axe use with qualified instruction before attempting a snow or ice route.

image.alt: Climber practicing movement on a snowy slope

name: Glacier travel
bio: Glacier travel involves hidden crevasses. Rope-team methods and crevasse rescue must be learned and practiced before a trip.

image.alt: Mountaineer roped on a snowy glacier slope

name: Weather and route decisions
bio: Use a current mountain forecast, identify objective hazards and agree on a turnaround time before setting out.

image.alt: Climber assessing a high snowy route

name: Rock climbing foundations
bio: Practice movement, belaying, knots and equipment checks with a qualified instructor in an appropriate learning setting.

image.alt: Roped climber ascending an outdoor rock wall

name: High-altitude health
bio: Learn how gradual ascent supports acclimatization and recognize when altitude symptoms mean stopping or descending.

image.alt: Mountaineer ascending a high mountain in cold weather
